projects.title: UNIDEX Digital Audio Mixer
projects.summary: Product leadership and engineering for a modular digital audio mixer platform.
projects.detailsMarkdown:
## Overview

Led the development of the UNIDEX platform across product definition, PCB design, manufacturing coordination, embedded Linux applications and web-based control interfaces.

## Product

A modular digital audio mixer available in 18- and 24-channel configurations, with up to 50 inputs, onboard audio processing and Audio over IP streaming.

projects.title: DFP-1010E RF Front-End Board
projects.summary: RF front-end board 0.1-6Ghz for a professional software-defined radio direction-finding system. RF x6 layer PCB
projects.detailsMarkdown:
## Overview

Designed the RF front-end board for a 10 MHz to 6 GHz receiver. The design integrates a programmable filter, low-noise amplifier, clock generator and up-converter, with a 0.3 to 6 GHz SDR output.

## Product

The board supports stacking and a shielding enclosure for the DFP-1010E Gigabit Ethernet Radio Direction Finding Bearing Processor, a professional-grade SDR platform.

projects.title: IPAC1 IP Audio Codec
projects.summary: Modular IP audio codec designed for professional broadcast and networked audio workflows.
projects.detailsMarkdown:
## Overview

Led product development, PCB design, manufacturing coordination, Linux application development and web-based control interfaces for the IPAC1 platform.

## Product

A modular IP audio codec with ADC and DAC expansion boards, GPIO and support for SIP, RTP, SRT and RIST transport protocols.

projects.title: CS100 Air Quality IoT Platform
projects.summary: Battery-powered IoT platform for indoor environmental measurement, monitoring and control.
projects.detailsMarkdown:
## Overview

Developed the PCB, ESP32 firmware, device interface and web-based monitoring interface for a low-power air-quality monitoring platform.

## Product

The CS100 measures CO2, temperature, humidity, dust and audio level. It also integrates motion detection, a motorized thermal camera, Wi-Fi connectivity and battery operation.

projects.title: 542 Digital Audio Processor
projects.summary: Digital broadcast-audio processor for FM radio and streaming applications.
projects.detailsMarkdown:
## Overview

Led product development, PCB design, manufacturing coordination, web interface development and the PIC32 and DSP platform architecture.

## Product

A multiband audio DSP processor for FM and streaming, including an FM multiplex generator, FM receiver and analyser, and Audio over IP streaming capabilities.

projects.title: VST Live Streaming Normalizer
projects.summary: Real-time VST audio processor for live loudness measurement and control.
projects.detailsMarkdown:
## Overview

Designed and developed the real-time audio DSP engine and user interface as a C++ desktop audio application using the JUCE framework.

## Product

A VST processor for live loudness control based on ITU-R BS.1770 and EBU R128 standards.
